INDEPENDENT REREVIEW — APPROVE cand-1ZPRYW072ZAC7G653YMZXWDVTB at exact 05e0746d65ea27db72d659d50616f006630c9df3 over sole parent/base e584ad6d8a1b6bc5cb28ac1c406a239114f1f48a. Scope is exactly docs/design/recall-alignment-visualization-court.md; git diff --check passes; the 489-line document digest is e7eab3c055374765cd12436d3bb8717e5b18380850f11071c31ec641199990ae.

The successor closes all five prior findings. It independently refuses row-absent Viterbi states and explicit zero-flow keys with row-absent endpoints; freezes finite positive row-support and incoming-flow thresholds for a categorical revisit and preserves exact masses; makes recall-bearing HTML local-sensitive by default with a separate disclosure/admission outcome and separately identified redaction; refuses non-finite logLikelihood as an ordinary measured statistic; and adds distinct mutation-bearing LongJump, thresholded-revisit, and typed external-excursion F courts with P held fixed where required.

Source recheck supports the load-bearing claims. AlignmentRow and FlowStep preserve explicit zero keys. HsmmResult.validated checks nomination/admission but not posterior-row key membership, while marginalsMatch reads absent keys as numeric zero. Its logLikelihood check rejects NaN but admits infinity. TransitionFeatures.between derives Backward and the LongJump value from typed source endpoints and measured positions. The court therefore attacks real current gaps rather than hypothetical ones.

No new blocker found. This approval covers the docs-only acceptance specification; it does not authorize Scala API vocabulary, implementation, film/corpus use, calibration claims, or landing.
